completePopup.title: Your vibe is complete!
completePopup.body: All three forms done. Now pull your people in.

culture.description: You go deep, not wide. You're in the museum before it opens and the local spot after it closes.

social.description: You came for one thing and stayed for the people. You know everyone's name by day two.

night.description: Things reveal themselves after dark and you know it. Mornings are for recovery.

food.description: You plan your days around meals, and you'll take the long way for the right place.

adventure.description: No plan is the plan. You decide late, travel light, and somehow always find the right people.

wellness.description: Slow, intentional, unbothered. You need at least one afternoon with absolutely nothing planned.
